FN-7Q4OE2-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 286
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Shane Stringer
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/19/2023
House Bill 286 as reported by the Committee on Public Safety and Homeland Security could
increase obligations of county and municipal governments by an undetermined amount
dependent on the cost to provide for the redaction of personal information of law enforcement
officers and employees from documents prior to disclosure.
